response.query: How must digital twins be calibrated and validated against firm historical traces (calibration protocol, goodness-of-fit metrics, out-of-sample validation) and which assumptions are acceptable when data are missing?
response.answer: Digital twins must be calibrated using historical data, validated with goodness-of-fit metrics, and tested out-of-sample; acceptable assumptions for missing data include interpolation or imputation techniques.
